visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair in a black tank top and a young woman with a ponytail in a white tank top sit on a gray couch indoors. They look directly at the lens, smiling and waving their hands enthusiastically while yellow text overlays appear. The room is softly lit with warm indoor lighting. (2) A cinematic montage follows, showing the man running shirtless on a wet road during a rainy day, then cycling on a black road bike. It transitions to him at a race finish line, wearing a medal, where the woman hugs him under a large red umbrella. (3) A high-angle close-up reveals a laptop screen displaying a marathon registration website with various category options and prices in Chinese characters. A cursor moves across the white and green interface. The background is a dimly lit room with a dark wooden table. (4) The woman is back in the indoor setting, looking distressed with her hands over her heart, speaking with an exaggerated pout. She suddenly collapses downward, disappearing from the frame. The background shows a modern living room with a shelf, books, and framed paintings. (5) Outdoors on a bright, sunny day with a vibrant blue sky and fluffy white clouds, the man and woman run side-by-side on a textured red athletic track. They wear modern white and black athletic apparel. In the foreground, a sleek gray metallic water bottle stands prominently on the ground. (6) Multiple close-up shots highlight the branded water bottle. It has a sleek, matte gray finish with white text. The man is shown opening the black lid with one hand and drinking while the woman stands behind him on the track. (7) A comparison sequence shows an old, scratched black bottle with white text overlays pointing out flaws. This alternates with four new bottles in white, black, silver, and gray colors lined up on a wooden floor in a bright room. (8) A hand places a black bottle on a silver digital scale, showing a numeric reading. Next, a folded pink umbrella is placed on the same scale to compare weight, highlighting the bottle's lightweight nature in a well-lit indoor environment. (9) A hand uses a silver metal key to scratch the interior of the metallic bottle, followed by a red plastic-handled metal spoon scraping the outer surface. The camera captures the texture of the matte metal and the lack of visible damage. (10) A series of shots show a yellow liquid, then a white milky liquid, and finally a brown liquid being poured into the mouth of the gray bottle. The woman is then seen drinking deeply from it in her brightly lit kitchen. (11) Inside a bright kitchen, the woman drinks from the bottle and looks surprised, gesturing with her hands. In the background, the shirtless man is busy at the sink. The woman smiles and gives a thumb-up gesture while holding the large bottle. (12) Close-up shots focus on the bottle's lid. A hand disassembles the white and black plastic components, removing a clear silicone ring. The parts are then rinsed under a stream of water from a silver faucet into a stainless steel sink. (13) The pair are seen stretching in their living room. The man wears a black tank top and the woman a white long-sleeved athletic top. They then stand up and run away from the camera, out through the doorway of the room. (14) Back on the orange athletic track, the woman suddenly sprints past the man with great speed. The man stops his run, looking bewildered with a hand touching his dark hair as she disappears from the side of the frame. Modern city buildings are visible in the far background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for the VERVE Titanium 'Zero-Second' water bottle. It uses a narrative about a couple training for a marathon to highlight the bottle's practical benefits, such as its light weight, durability, and resistance to stains and odors.
